role: RAW-TEXT-ONLY DISPLACEMENT CONTROL for the V3 arm: identical rows, splits and recipe, no criterion block, document truncated to the budget the V3 block left it

budget_derivation.block_tokens_source: v3grid_nc_outcome/manifest.json truncation.block_tokens -- build_v3_cell.py measures it as len(tok(block, add_special_tokens=False)) on the FIRST TRAIN ROW's rendered block, so it is a per-cell scalar, not a per-row length

budget_equivalence.claim: a V3 row overruns 1024 iff 1+n_block+n_doc > 1024, i.e. n_doc > 1023-n_block; a raw-matched row overruns its budget iff 1+n_doc > 1024-n_block, the SAME condition. Equal truncation rates therefore certify equal document budgets.

trainer_entry_reason: split fractions inside the stock 80/10/10 +-2%% gate
recipe: IDENTICAL to the V3 arm (frozen 8B LoRA r16/a32, lr 5e-5, bs16, eval_bs 32, grad-accum 1, 2 epochs, gradient checkpointing, seed 42, the cell's own selection_split, NO --class_weight_auto) EXCEPT: no criterion block, and max_length 775 instead of 1024
only_difference_from_v3: the k=20 'name: score' block is absent (text is the raw document)
class_weight_note: deliberately NOT used: the V3 and T chains for these cells used no class weighting, and adding it would confound the block's contribution with a loss change
byte_assertions: per split, n equals the V3 arm's and the original dense split's
judgement equal elementwise to the V3 arm's split rows
group equal elementwise to the V3 arm's split rows
did carried verbatim from the V3 arm's split rows, same order
every V3 text ENDS WITH '\n' + this arm's text (suffix derivation)
dropping the block's k+1 leading lines from the V3 text reproduces this arm's text (independent line-strip derivation)
raw-matched truncation rate at the reduced budget reproduces the V3 arm's with-block rate at 1024 to <0.01
leakage_rules: no criterion scores are rendered at all in this arm
y NEVER appears in a prompt
splits are the V3 arm's split CSVs with the block removed, row for row
